bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
container=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
src_token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$container")"
src_db="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$container")"
test -f "$src_token" && test -f "$src_db" || { echo CREATOR_MOUNT_SOURCE_MISSING; exit 61; }
uid_token="$(stat -c %u "$src_token")"
uid_db="$(stat -c %u "$src_db")"
gid_token="$(stat -c %g "$src_token")"
gid_db="$(stat -c %g "$src_db")"
node_uid="$(docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint id create-videobot:local-poll -u)"
test "$node_uid" -ge 1 || { echo CREATOR_IMAGE_USER_INVALID; exit 62; }
if test "$uid_token" = "$node_uid" && test "$uid_db" = "$node_uid";then echo CREATOR_SECRET_OWNERS_MATCH_NODE_UID=PASS; exit 0; fi
if test "$uid_token" = "$node_uid" && test "$uid_db" != "$node_uid";then echo CREATOR_DB_SECRET_OWNER_DIFFERS_FROM_NODE_UID; exit 63; fi
if test "$uid_token" != "$node_uid" && test "$uid_db" = "$node_uid";then echo CREATOR_TOKEN_SECRET_OWNER_DIFFERS_FROM_NODE_UID; exit 64; fi
echo CREATOR_BOTH_SECRET_OWNERS_DIFFER_FROM_NODE_UID
exit 65
